name: Land of Wars
storyline: Inspired by the fantasy universe of the 'Mundo Dividido' saga by David Parra, adventurers arrive at the capital of Zalestra to forge their destiny in a living world. Beneath peaceful villages and ancient trade routes lie perilous subterranean catacombs, forgotten sewers, and crypts full of ancient relics waiting to be claimed.
summary:
Land of Wars is a classic dark medieval fantasy persistent browser-based MMORPG set in the realm of Zalestra. Built around a skill-based progression system without fixed character classes, players develop their combat, gathering, survival, and crafting proficiencies through direct practice.

The game features a player-driven economy with deep crafting mechanics, dynamic weather and day/night cycles, and first-person dungeon crawling with real-time tactical combat, lockpicking, and deadly traps that can be tackled solo or in cooperative parties. It runs natively in modern web browsers without downloads or plugins.
